description: Sameer Africa Limited is a Kenya-based company that is principally engaged in the manufacture, importation and sale of tyres and the letting of premises. The Company's product range includes passenger textile and steel belted radials, 4x4 tires, light truck radial and bias, truck and bus, agricultural, industrial and Off-The-Road tires under the brand name, Yana. The Company produces both tube type and tubeless tires and also produces tubes and flaps. The Company's subsidiaries include Sameer Africa (Uganda) Limited, Sameer Africa (Tanzania) Limited, Yana Tyre Centre Limited, Sameer Industrial Park Limited and Taqwa Trading Limited.
